title: Interior and Silence
author: Lior Hartwell
blurb: Edmund Reyes, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return to the place where the story went wrong before the house sale closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
